# Restora Centre for Recovery

> Restora Centre for Recovery is a licensed, physician-led addiction treatment and mental health recovery sanctuary located on Old Namanga Rd in Kitengela, Kajiado County, Kenya.

Restora Centre provides compassionate, dignified, evidence-based care for individuals and families dealing with substance use disorders (alcohol, prescription drugs, illicit substances) and co-occurring mental health conditions.

## Contact & Location
- **Organization**: Restora Centre for Recovery
- **Location**: Old Namanga Rd, Kitengela, Kajiado County, Kenya
- **24/7 Phone Helpline**: +254 795 180 704
- **WhatsApp Support**: +254 795 180 704
- **Email**: restoracentreforrecovery@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://www.restorarehabcenter.com/
- **Visits**: By appointment to protect patient privacy and dignity

## Core Treatment Programs

### 1. Medical Detox
- **Description**: Safe, physician-supervised withdrawal management to stabilize patients physically and manage withdrawal symptoms with 24/7 medical supervision.
- **Duration**: Based on medical assessment (typically 3 to 10 days).
- **Details**: https://www.restorarehabcenter.com/programs.html#detox

### 2. Residential Care (Inpatient Rehabilitation)
- **Description**: Structured residential healing programs providing distance from environmental triggers in a serene, peaceful sanctuary.
- **Duration**: Flexible 30, 60, or 90-day programs.
- **Features**: Individual psychotherapy, peer group sessions, daily mindfulness and yoga, wholesome nutrition, physical recovery support.
- **Details**: https://www.restorarehabcenter.com/programs.html#residential

### 3. Outpatient Care
- **Description**: Intensive day and evening therapy programs for patients transitioning back to daily life or individuals with stable home environments who cannot take leave from work or studies.
- **Schedule**: 3 to 5 therapy sessions per week.
- **Details**: https://www.restorarehabcenter.com/programs.html#outpatient

### 4. Aftercare & Relapse Prevention
- **Description**: Long-term ongoing support network following discharge to ensure sustainable sobriety.
- **Features**: Weekly alumni support circles, regular therapist check-ins, sober peer mentors, 24/7 crisis guidance.
- **Details**: https://www.restorarehabcenter.com/programs.html#aftercare

### 5. Family Support Program
- **Description**: Dedicated counseling and education for family members and caregivers to repair trust and establish healthy boundaries.
- **Details**: https://www.restorarehabcenter.com/resources.html

## Admissions & Next Steps
- **Intake**: Call or message +254 795 180 704 any time for immediate, confidential consultation.
- **Pricing**: Transparent fee schedule with zero surprise costs; assistance with private insurance and transparent private-pay options.
- **Admissions Guide**: https://www.restorarehabcenter.com/admissions.html
